module.summary: default skin: a drawing function for every control plus the skin tables (skin.general, per-control colors/borders/DrawControl etc.); finally returns skin.

DrawBorder.desc: Draws the 1px beveled border with borderColor/borderColor2; when state.pressed is true the two colors swap.

DrawBackground.desc: Fills the control rect with backgroundColor via TRIANGLE_STRIP and _DrawBackground.

_DrawScrollbar.desc: Draws the scrollbar track and, depending on type 'horizontal'/'vertical', the grip positioned by pos and sized by visiblePercent. (internal)

_DrawBackground.desc: Vertex callback that draws a backgroundColor rect for gl.BeginEnd. (internal)

_DrawTabBackground.desc: Draws the tab background inset by 2px on every side. (internal)

DrawWindow.desc: DrawControl for windows: draws the background and the border.

DrawButton.desc: Draws the button background and border, and centers the caption with obj.font when one is set.

_DrawTriangle.desc: Draws a small focusColor triangle on the right side as the dropdown indicator. (internal)

DrawComboBox.desc: Draws the button look first, then overlays the dropdown triangle.

DrawCursor.desc: Emits the four vertices of the text cursor rect (for gl.BeginEnd).

DrawEditBox.desc: Draws the editbox: background, a border colored with focusColor when focused (otherwise borderColor2/borderColor), text clipped by offset/cursor, and a time-based blinking cursor while focused.

DrawPanel.desc: DrawControl for panels: draws the background and the border.

DrawItemBkGnd.desc: Draws a list item background (dark blue when selected, otherwise light translucent blue) with a 1px border on top.

DrawScrollPanel.desc: Draws the vertical/horizontal scrollbars inside the coordinate frame offset by clientArea, sized from contentArea.

DrawTrackbar.desc: Draws the trackbar: a horizontal track line and a grip positioned by (value-min)/(max-min).

DrawCheckbox.desc: Draws the checkbox caption, box and border, plus a check mark when state.checked is true.

DrawColorbars.desc: Draws the R/G/B/A color bars, the current-color preview block on the right and the border.

DrawLine.desc: Draws a vertical line when style starts with 'v', otherwise a horizontal one (1px two-color line using borderColor/borderColor2).

DrawDragGrip.desc: Draws the drag grip in the top-left corner of a window using TRIANGLES.

DrawResizeGrip.desc: When obj.resizable is true (or tweakResizable in tweak mode), draws three resize lines in the bottom-right corner with GL.LINES.

DrawTreeviewNode.desc: When the node is the treeview's selected node, draws a translucent blue background and a dark blue border highlight.

DrawTreeviewNodeTree.desc: Draws the tree node connector lines (a vertical plus a horizontal line, without the downward part for a parent's last child) and the expand/collapse icon when the node has children.

DrawTabBarItem.desc: Draws the tab background and border with the caption centered; when selected it temporarily uses focusColor for the text and restores the font color afterwards.

fileDesc: default skin implementation: drawing functions for every control plus the skin default tables (skin.general, skin.button, skin.window, ...).
